storm.title: 29 July 2025: Zakhira under six feet of water
storm.title_hi: 29 जुलाई 2025: ज़खीरा में छह फ़ीट पानी
storm.note: Hourly shape approximated from IMD figures: 63.5 mm at Safdarjung between 08:30 and 11:30, 68.1 mm by 14:30. Rain was very uneven: Ridge, near Zakhira, recorded 129.5 mm. Each spot is scaled by distance-weighted totals from 6 IMD stations (Ayanagar is a morning-only reading).
